_comment: Synthesized Microsoft Senior PM scenario. Pins two failure modes that are role-agnostic but easy to overlook on PM (vs SDE) sessions: (1) placeholder leak — LLM emits ₹X / [amount] when it should substitute, this is rare but catastrophic when it happens; (2) number-echo with a phrasing the original Flipkart fixture didn't cover ('your target of ₹X'). Markdown leak with backticks is also tested here — a different markdown variant from the underscore italics in Flipkart.

turns._label: Microsoft placeholder leak — LLM left ₹X unsubstituted
turns.llmOutput: I appreciate the data point. Let me see if I can move to ₹X LPA total CTC for you.

turns._label: Microsoft number-echo with 'your target of' phrasing
turns.llmOutput: Understood — your target of ₹55 LPA is helpful context. Let me see what we can do within the band.

turns._label: Microsoft markdown leak — backtick code formatting
turns.llmOutput: On the equity side, RSU grant is `40 LPA` over 4 years with a 1-year cliff. Joining bonus would be **₹5 LPA**.
I heard ₹70 LPA from you. Let me see what I can do — I can stretch to ₹65 LPA total CTC. Does that move us closer?
